summary: Iteration 2 full regression + new-feature testing for Pedilo (Lo de Juan). 37/37 pytest backend tests passed (23 regression from iter 1 + 14 new covering orders, business hours, image upload/serve, product images). Playwright e2e validated: closed banner + 'Tienda cerrada' disabled checkout button when override=closed, POST /api/public/orders fires before WhatsApp window.open, admin Pedidos tab with pending badge (shows count=2), filter pills, stat cards, order rows; AdminConfig Horarios with 7 sched rows + auto/open/closed overrides saving & persisting; AdminProducts editor exposes Galería pe-gallery-file input; object-storage image upload works end-to-end (PUT /api/upload/image -> GET /api/files/{path} serves the image with Cache-Control).

minor.issue: No validation of the ?status query param — unknown values return an empty list instead of 400. Low impact (admin-only, filter UI is a whitelisted pill set).
MIME-type is trusted from the client; no server-side magic-byte check. Max-size check (5MB) is enforced. Acceptable for MVP but worth hardening later.

Returns 404 if the file is not in db.files even if object exists in storage — fine, but cache-control=public,max-age=86400 means deleted-from-DB files can remain cached client-side for 24h; acceptable.

issues: Badge renders glued to the label ('Pedidos2') because it has no left margin/gap in the tab button flexbox. Cosmetic only.
Time inputs use the browser-native <input type='time'> (shadcn time-picker is not used). Works, but inconsistent with other shadcn pickers in the app.

action_items: (Optional) Add a small gap/margin between the Pedidos label and the pending-count badge in AdminDashboard tabs (cosmetic).
(Optional) Validate ?status query on GET /api/admin/orders against the allowed set and return 400 otherwise.
(Optional) Harden POST /api/upload/image with server-side magic-byte check (Pillow / python-magic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~870 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend extracting routers: auth, public, admin (categories/products/combos/config/orders), uploads. Still cohesive for now.
is_shop_open() correctly handles overnight windows (close < open) for fri/sat, and closed='true' short-circuit. Good.
put_object/get_object retry once on 403 by refreshing storage_key — resilient.
GET /api/files is public by design (cache-friendly image serving) and guards with db.files.find_one({is_deleted:False}) — correct.

Order creation is public & unauthenticated — expected so the customer can place orders. Input validation on items/address done; payment_method not whitelisted (any string is accepted). Low risk but worth pinning to {'efectivo','transferencia'}.
CORS still uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True; browsers only accept this because allow_origin_regex='.*' echoes the origin back. Functional but tighten for production.
All Mongo reads use {'_id': 0} projection — no ObjectId leaks.
Frontend /upload/image handler returns relative URL ('/api/files/...'); CustomerApp & admin consume it correctly via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Schedule field stored as Dict[str, Dict[str,str]] with 'closed' as string 'true'/'false' — works, but a boolean would be cleaner (current code already str().lower() compares).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pedilo_v2.py (new: 14 tests for iter 2 features, all passing)
seed_data_creation: No seed modifications needed. Test orders/products/categories created during tests are cleaned up via DELETE in each test's finally block. Config snapshot/restore fixture preserves Horarios + override state around each test. Final config was restored to slogan='menos vueltas, más pedidos' and open_override='auto' via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression baseline: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Two test files: test_pedilo_api.py (iter1) + test_pedilo_v2.py (iter2). Customer flow: adding first product opens an options drawer — must click 'Agregar al pedido' before the floating-cart appears. WhatsApp intercept is done by stubbing window.open = (u)=>{window.__opened=u;...}. To toggle shop closed in UI tests use AdminConfig override buttons and remember to restore to 'auto' via API (urllib/requests from the test host is 403'd by the CDN UA block — use page.evaluate(fetch) from inside the browser or run from inside the container via the test harness which is allowed). Orders stats is timezone-aware (America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires).
rca of the issue: No outstanding bugs. One transient 403 was encountered when calling /api/public/config via python urllib from the test-host IP (CDN bot-UA block); the fix is to use requests (allowed) or page.evaluate(fetch) from within the browser — both confirmed working.
